name: vai vem vem
description: Jamaican artist Dre50 brings cross-Caribbean heat to the CWI catalog with "vai vem vem," a co-production with Black Lansky that released September 30, 2026. The title — Portuguese for the push and pull of coming and going — sets the tone for a seductive, hypnotic record built for late-night dancefloors. Dre50 rides the beat with the fluidity of an artist fluent in island rhythm, and the production answers with an 808-driven groove that sits comfortably in the underground hip hop lane, trap drums anchoring the sway. There is a dangerous charm to "vai vem vem": seductive on the surface, loaded with street narrative underneath. The polished mix keeps every element crisp — the percussion, the low end, Dre50's commanding vocal presence. Released under Cumulative Web Inc, it marks Dre50 as one of the roster's most internationally flavored voices, a bridge between Kingston energy and the CWI sound. "vai vem vem" does not chase trends; it sets a mood and holds it.
